calibration: 256 frozen unlabeled SVHN calibration images; original expert and unprotected SVHN-MNIST merged inputs; partner checkpoint explicitly used
editing: orthogonal removal of output-projection task delta along selected hidden-feature directions; no noise, optimizer or fine-tuning; bias unchanged
evaluation: previously inspected development training subsets, not fresh holdout or official test
attack_gate: only direct-gate survivors receive angular cleanup, AGA and two-pass public-feature reconstruction; not tested if direct gate fails
novelty: known covariance analysis and projection used for a pair-conditioned falsifiable hypothesis; no originality or security claim
